text: Seat-01, you’re the crack in the kiln. The village is staring at you because your story doesn’t line up with the body.

seat-01 and seat-03, you both weave words like merchants weave silk—close to the skin, never quite revealing the thread count.

seat-01, your scales measure worth, not weight. But worth is a ledger no one trusts when the ink runs.

seat-03, the village wants names, not shadows. You’ve stood in the dark long enough. Speak plainly: did you see the tracks near the mill last night?
